title: Black Badge
infotainment: SPIRIT (BMW iDrive 8 derivative); 12.3-inch central touchscreen, full-width digital instrument cluster, controller knob and voice (Eleanor)
adasStandard: Driving Assistant Professional standard (same suite as base Spectre): adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go, lane-keeping assist, lane-change assistant, evasion aid, automatic emergency braking with pedestrian/cyclist detection, traffic-sign recognition, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert, surround-view 360 camera, parking distance control. ACC + lane-centering operative to 130 mph; low-speed hands-off Traffic Jam Assistant to ~36 mph. Adds Black-Badge-exclusive Infinity and Spirited drive modes with launch-control. Source: https://insideevs.com/news/751063/rolls-royce-spectre-black-badge/ , https://www.press.rolls-roycemotorcars.com/rolls-royce-motor-cars-pressclub/article/detail/T0448145EN/
adasOptional: Driving Assistant Professional is standard at this price point; surround-view 360, Drive Recorder, head-up display, and night-vision pedestrian detection are also standard. Source: https://www.rollsroycepasadena.com/rolls-royce-information/spectre-technology/
rearViewCameraNotes: High-resolution rear-view camera standard with dynamic guideline overlays, integrated into the surround-view system. Source: https://www.rolls-roycemotorcars.com/en_US/showroom/spectre.html
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-view 360-degree camera system standard, top-down and 3D virtual exterior views. No Honda LaneWatch-style single-side camera. Source: https://www.rollsroycepasadena.com/rolls-royce-information/spectre-technology/
subscriptionFeatures: No subscription-gated hardware features publicly disclosed. Connected-services data plan and OTA updates are included for the warranty period; post-warranty terms are dealer-quoted. Source: https://www.rolls-roycemotorcars.com/en_US/ownership/your-motor-car.html
drmNotes: Same as base Spectre: Rolls-Royce Connected and Whispers require cellular for remote app features, eCall, and OTA updates; the car drives normally offline. No public reports of remote feature reduction. Source: https://www.rollsroycemotorcarsparamus.com/ownership/rolls-royce-whispers-app.htm
killSwitchNotes: No federally-mandated impaired-driving kill switch is installed yet; NHTSA's IIJA Section 24220 rulemaking remained unfinalized through MY2025. BMW-derived driver-monitoring camera is present and used today only for attention warnings on Highway Assistant, not vehicle disablement. Source: https://www.kbb.com/car-news/nhtsas-new-kill-switch-law-approaches-key-deadline/
knownIssues: Brake-system servomotor weld recall extends to 2025 Black Badge builds. Edmunds road-test of the Black Badge noted ride harshness in firmer Sport mode and tire-life concerns from the more aggressive setup. Long-term reliability data sparse given low volumes. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/car-news/2025-rolls-royce-spectre-black-badge-tested.html , https://www.cars.com/research/rolls_royce-spectre/recalls/
recalls: 2024-2025 NHTSA recall: integrated brake system servomotor weld failure (loss of power brake, rear brake, ABS, DSC); remedy is full module replacement at no cost. Source: https://www.cars.com/research/rolls_royce-spectre-2024/recalls/
stateIncentives: Goodwood (UK) assembly disqualifies the Spectre from IRA Section 30D. Federal 45W commercial-lease credit expired Sept 30, 2025. Rolls-Royce currently offers a $5,000 manufacturer lease credit on MY2025 Black Badge Spectres. State EV incentives universally capped below the trim's $490K+ MSRP. Source: https://electrek.co/2025/11/11/rolls-royce-gets-in-on-the-ev-price-war-with-new-5000-lease-promo/

title: Spectre
infotainment: SPIRIT (BMW iDrive 8 derivative customized for Rolls-Royce); 12.3-inch central touchscreen plus full-width digital instrument cluster; controller knob, voice, and touch input; Eleanor voice assistant on the steering-wheel button
adasStandard: Driving Assistant Professional (BMW Group level-2 ADAS stack rebadged for Rolls-Royce). Includes: adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go, lane-keeping assist, lane-departure warning, lane-change assistant, evasion aid, forward-collision warning, automatic emergency braking with pedestrian/cyclist detection, traffic-sign recognition, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert, parking distance control (front/rear), and low-speed hands-off Traffic Jam Assistant (operative up to ~36 mph in qualifying conditions). The ACC + lane centering system functions up to 130 mph. Source: https://evkx.net/models/rolls-royce/spectre/spectre/ , https://www.rollsroycepasadena.com/rolls-royce-information/spectre-technology/
adasOptional: Driving Assistant Professional is standard at this price point; no meaningfully higher tier offered. Camera surround-view (360 deg) and Drive Recorder are also standard. Source: https://www.rollsroycepasadena.com/rolls-royce-information/spectre-technology/
rearViewCameraNotes: High-resolution rear-view camera standard with dynamic guideline overlays, integrated into the surround-view system. Display is on the 12.3-inch SPIRIT central touchscreen. Source: https://www.rolls-roycemotorcars.com/en_US/showroom/spectre.html
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-view 360-degree camera system standard, including top-down composite view and 3D virtual exterior view. No Honda LaneWatch-style single-side camera; side awareness uses radar/ultrasonic blind-spot detection plus the surround-view cameras. Source: https://www.rollsroycepasadena.com/rolls-royce-information/spectre-technology/
subscriptionFeatures: Rolls-Royce has not publicly disclosed subscription-gated hardware features on the Spectre. In the ultra-luxury segment the brand treats nearly every feature as standard or bespoke-included at order. BMW Group's 2022-2023 trial of subscription heated seats was retired before Spectre launched. Connected-services data plan and OTA updates are included in the new-vehicle warranty period; renewal terms after the included period are dealer-quoted rather than publicly listed. Source: https://www.rolls-roycemotorcars.com/en_US/ownership/your-motor-car.html
drmNotes: Rolls-Royce Connected requires cellular connectivity for remote app features (Whispers), eCall (Rolls-Royce Assist), and OTA updates. The car drives normally without server connectivity — propulsion, ADAS, infotainment, and CarPlay/Android Auto work offline. No public reports of BMW Group remotely reducing post-sale features on the Spectre. Source: https://www.rollsroycemotorcarsparamus.com/ownership/rolls-royce-whispers-app.htm , https://www.rolls-roycemotorcars.com/en_US/ownership/your-motor-car.html
killSwitchNotes: No federally-mandated impaired-driving kill switch is installed yet; NHTSA's IIJA Section 24220 rulemaking remained unfinalized through MY2025. The BMW-derived driver-monitoring camera is present and used today only for attention/drowsiness warnings on the Highway Assistant feature, not for vehicle disablement. No public statement on bypassability. Source: https://www.kbb.com/car-news/nhtsas-new-kill-switch-law-approaches-key-deadline/
knownIssues: Early production (Oct-Dec 2023 build) had an electrical ground cable defect with adhesive residue increasing resistance and creating fire risk; recalled 2024. Brake-system servomotor weld failure recall affects 2024 and 2025 builds — replacement of the integrated brake control module is the remedy. Long-term reliability data is sparse given low volumes. Source: https://www.greencarreports.com/news/1142154_2024-rolls-royce-spectre-ev-recalled , https://www.cars.com/research/rolls_royce-spectre/recalls/
recalls: 2024-01 NHTSA recall: insufficient electrical ground at front motor / chassis cable, fire risk (early 2024 builds, ~90% of recalled VINs affected). 2024-2025 NHTSA recall: integrated brake system servomotor welds may break causing loss of power-brake assist, rear brake, ABS, and DSC; remedy is full integrated brake system replacement at no cost. Source: https://www.greencarreports.com/news/1142154_2024-rolls-royce-spectre-ev-recalled , https://www.cars.com/research/rolls_royce-spectre-2024/recalls/
stateIncentives: Spectre is assembled at Goodwood (UK), so it never qualified for IRA Section 30D purchase credit. Federal commercial-lease (45W) credit expired Sept 30, 2025. Rolls-Royce now offers a $5,000 manufacturer lease credit on MY2025/2026 Spectres in lieu of the expired federal credit. State EV incentives are universally capped well below the Spectre's $400K+ MSRP and do not apply. Source: https://electrek.co/2025/11/11/rolls-royce-gets-in-on-the-ev-price-war-with-new-5000-lease-promo/
